description: ol-style-name-case (issue #854): the Tutor profile's `challenge` (spec/conformance.md:244) written non-lowercase. This fixture exists to pin an ABSORPTION rather than a spelling: when #854 derived this lint from the registries, `challenge` was the one built-in name with no registry at all and was documented as unreachable; #838 then registered TUTOR_PRIMITIVE_ARITY in PROFILE_PRIMITIVE_ARITY_TABLES and the coverage appeared with no change to checker-style.ts. The accompanying `ol-unknown-command` is the separate, pre-existing VISIBILITY half — `collectVisibleNames` has no Tutor branch yet, which is #841's work under epic #900 — so a slice that gives Tutor visibility should expect to drop that diagnostic from this fixture and keep the style warning.

diagnostics.message: i don't know how to CHALLENGE. check the spelling, or define it with 'define'.
CHALLENGE should be lowercase snake_case, like a learner would read it aloud.
